decisions.rule: Separate recognized lending collateral, unrecognized customer collateral, derivatives collateral, customer funds, FCM capital and token-level XRP collateral. Never infer XRP from aggregate 'other crypto' or unrecognized collateral.
Preserve issuer and distributor definitions/periods. Circle's USDC-on-platform metric and Coinbase's average USDC-in-products metric are not directly comparable.
Treat SBIC East Japan as distinct from SBI Holdings. Treat SBI Circle Holdings/Circle SBI Japan K.K., SBI Startale Marketing and SBI Ripple Asia as separate legal entities and relationships.
Represent SBI's Ripple/XRP, Circle/USDC/Arc and Startale/JPYSC initiatives as parallel rails; only label operational integrations when live network/contract evidence exists.
A partnership, MOU, planned collateral feature or future public-chain migration is not a live transaction rail or collateral position.
Institutional disclosures are context features only until point-in-time historical coverage and walk-forward predictive contribution are measured.
